id: "example-0001"
class: "spawner.decide"
urgency: "p1"
from: "example secretary"

log_lines: - {"at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "event": "created", "hash": "98b212b6b39f90826ff4b18444d9e520406c199faaf3d622bfe02969c700d568", "header": {"at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "body": "bodies/example-0001.txt", "class": "spawner.decide", "from": "example secretary", "id": "example-0001", "ref": {"patch": "example.patch", "submission": "3c52c517361c"}, "summary": "push failed: check: check changed HEAD (branch or commit)", "to": "example", "urgency": "p1"}, "id": "example-0001", "key": ["example secretary", {"patch": "example.patch", "submission": "3c52c517361c"}, "spawner.decide"], "to": "example"}

notes: Only the original branch is restored; HEAD and the other branch's work are left alone.

files.check.sh:
git rev-parse HEAD >> ../checked.log || exit 9
test -f ../notes/mac-check.lock/owner.json || exit 9
exec "$@"
